events.what_it_is: A two-day NYFW pop-up inspired by a New York stoop, with legwear, beauty and hair touch-ups, a photo booth and content-friendly activations.
events.what_is_free: Public admission, coffee, branded stickers, hairstyle touch-ups, a photo booth and skincare sampling/touch-ups are advertised. Hand embroidery is free only with purchase of the specified Calzedonia knee highs.
events.caveats: Verified current listings explicitly describe the event as open to the public. Complimentary items and services are subject to capacity or supplies. Free embroidery requires purchase of the 20 Denier Hosiery Knee Highs.
events.practical_notes: September 12 and 13, 12-5 PM daily at 188 Lafayette Street. No RSVP or organizer-approval requirement is published in the verified listings.

events.address: North Esplanade by The Rink, 45 Rockefeller Plaza, New York, NY 10111
events.what_it_is: A public NYFW Sally Hansen activation at Rockefeller Center spotlighting the Miracle Gel Bold Glam collection.
events.what_is_free: Public access is free. The official Rockefeller Center page confirms the activation and location; promotional beauty services or products may be capacity- or supply-dependent.
events.caveats: Rockefeller Center lists the activation as part of its public NYFW programming. Exact on-site service availability is not guaranteed in the official listing.
events.practical_notes: Saturday, September 12 from 12-6 PM and Sunday, September 13 from 10 AM-6 PM at the North Esplanade by The Rink. No advance RSVP is published.

events.event_name: Love, Kelly × Crocs NYFW Runway Show
events.what_it_is: Love, Kelly's Season 4 NYFW runway show in collaboration with Crocs, featuring one-of-one designs and the release of music tied to the collection.
events.what_is_free: No ticket price is published in the current listing, but access is not open walk-in: prospective guests must RSVP and be selected for the list.
events.caveats: The current event copy says guests should RSVP 'for the chance to secure your name on the list' and that RSVP is the first step to access. Treat submission as a request, not confirmed admission.
events.practical_notes: Saturday, September 12, 8-8:30 PM at 15 W 36th Street. Do not travel assuming entry unless you receive confirmation that you are on the list.
